name: Knott's Sutter's Funnel Cake Powdered Sugar Funnel Cake (Seed-Free Mod)
whyItWorks: Crispy fried funnel cake batter dusted with powdered sugar. By omitting the seeded boysenberry fruit topping, you eliminate millions of sharp berry seeds.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Funnel Cake plain with powdered sugar only (specifically pass on the boysenberry fruit topping).
watchOuts: Deep-fried dough carries oil; share with tablemates
